result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for a vendor handling customer data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. The original provision is unchanged. However, requiring all coverages to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. Any post-termination requirement should be limited to applicable claims-made E&O and cyber coverage and expressly structured as tail coverage if intended.
